Plot marginal and pairwise VAF distributions of the sorted samples.

Source: R/plot_data.R
plot_vaf.Rd

Every column whose name contains "VAF" is treated as one sample (columns starting with "normal" are dropped). Columns named as returned by ProCESS' simulate_seq() with an epistate labelling (e.g. `Sampling_1_N.VAF`, `Sampling_1_P.VAF`) are renamed to `VAF 1-`, `VAF 1+`, ...

Usage

plot_vaf(muts, colors = NULL, vaf_cut = 0.02, size = 0.01, assemble = TRUE)

Arguments

muts

Mutation table with VAF columns and, optionally, a `label` column.

colors

Named vector of label colors.

vaf_cut

Minimum VAF shown in the marginal histograms.

size

Point size of the pairwise scatter plots.

assemble

If TRUE, return one figure with the pairwise scatter plots on top and the marginal histograms below; otherwise a list with elements `marginals` and `pairs`.

Value

A ggplot object, or a list of ggplot objects.

Examples

data("muts")
PEPI:::plot_vaf(muts, vaf_cut = 0.03, size = 0.1)
